findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Mold observed on the upper baffle of the ice machine. Ensure that food-contact surfaces remain clean to sight and touch and are properly sanitized. The baffled was cleaned off with sanitizer water during the inspection. Corrected on site. No follow-up required. 

4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed water and debris on bottom of chest cooler. Ensure non-food contact surfaces are cleaned as needed to prevent build-up. Clean cooler bottom. 
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed soiled debris in walk-in cooler. Ensure walls are cleaned as needed. Ceiling tile.  Clean walls. 
750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings. 
750-1210(b) Walls and ceilings in walk-in refrigeration units, food prepartion areas, equipment washing areas, and toilet rooms shall be smooth, light-cored, non-absorbant, and easily cleanable. Concrete or pumice block in these locations shall be finished and sealed to provide a cleanable surface.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.comment: See previous inspection report.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.comment: See previous inspection report.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment:
Observed no thermometer in the reach in cooler at the bar storing orange juice. All refrigeration units storing potentially hazardous foods shall have thermometers. Provide a thermometer for this unit.
. . 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment: Observed cups of popcorn and popcorn oil stored uncovered in the side room adjacent to the pop corn machine. Food shall be protected at all times during storage and display. Keep food covered to prevent potential contamination.750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.750-130(a) Food shall be stored in clean, covered containers once being removed from the original package.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment: Observed no quat test strips at the bar. Chlorine test strips were available at the bar. Quat is used as the sanitizer. Provide test strips for quat to ensure the appropriate concentration of sanitizer is used.750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: Observed the popcorn machine to be soiled with a heavy accumulation of grease and food debris. Clean and maintain popcorn machine to prevent cross contamination. Food contact surfaces shall be cleaned after each use.750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: Observed single service cups stored on the floor in the back storage room. Single service items shall be protected at all times during storage. Single service items shall be stored at least six inches from the floor. Cease to store single service items on the floor.750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment: Observed a leak underneath the third basin of the three compartment sink. Leak is causing the raw, untreated floor underneath the sink to warp. Repair the leak to avoid providing water and harborage for pests. 750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Cross-connections, back-siphonage, back-flow prevented
findings.comment:
(1) Observed no air gap between the drain lines of soda gun and ice bin and the drain underneath the ice bin. (2) Observed no air gap between the drain lines of the soda gun, ice bin, and three compartment sink underneath the three compartment sink.  Provide air gaps at least twice the diameter of the plumbing (minimum one inch) between the drain lines and the drain.
750-290 Ice storage bins shall be drained through an air gap. Provide an air gap.750-1060 There shall be no cross-connection between the safe-water supply and any unsafe or questionable water supply, or any source of pollution through which the safe water supply might become contaminated. Abate in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: Observed no covered receptacle in the men's restroom or employee restroom. Provide a covered receptacle in all restrooms.750-1110d Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily cleanable, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.comment: Observed 30+ drain flies underneath the three compartment sink. Floor at the bar is raw/unsealed wood. A leak under the third basin of the three compartment sink has warped the board creating harborage for pests. Replace unsealed wood under the three compartment sink to prevent providing harborage for pests. Repair the leak at the three compartment sink to avoid providing a water source for pests. Seal and clean floor underneath the three compartment sink to prevent providing food, water, and harborage for pests.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: Observed raw, unsealed floors through the length of the bar. Multiple gaps and warped flooring was observed. Replace or repair floor to provide a smooth, easily cleanable surface. Seal flooring and eliminate gaps. Management states that floor is in the process of being replaced.750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
UPON NEXT REMODEL: Replace acoustic ceiling tiles above bar, restrooms, and ice machine. Provide a smooth and easily cleanable ceiling tiles in food preparation, food service, or food storage areas.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment: (1) Observed a red bull cooler stored in the back room unused. Cooler appears to be soiled with what appears to be mold and dust. Remove all unnecessary equipment from the facility to prevent providing harborage for pests. (2) Observed brown bowls for popcorn stored underneath the ice bin. Soiled dishware shall be cleaned nightly and stored in a manner that protects the food contact surface. Cease to store soiled dishware underneath the ice bin.

750-650a Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment:
REPEAT VIOLATION: The light above the ice machine in back does not have a cover. Provide a cover or shatterproof bulbs.

Light in above the storage rack with clean towels and plastic utensils without a cover in the back room. Provide a cover or shatterproof bulbs.
750-1240 All lights in the food prep, food storage or kitchen area of a establishment must be properly shielded (i.e. either have a physical shield or be a shatter resistant bulb) so as to reduce the potential for cross contamination in case of breakage.  Provide properly shielded lights.
